title: MiniJinja
subtitle: Render Jinja-style templates directly from SQL
intro: Turn JSON context into rendered text using familiar Jinja variables, filters, loops, and conditions. Generate one HTML fragment, message, or configuration block per row while keeping the source data and rendering query together.

reference.name: minijinja_render(template, ...)
reference.description: Render a template with optional named settings.

reference.name: minijinja_render_with_context
reference.description: Pass template, per-row JSON context, then options.

reference.name: autoescape := false
reference.description: Disable HTML escaping for plain text and other non-HTML output.

reference.name: {{ value | upper }}
reference.description: Interpolate a value and apply a filter.

reference.name: {% for x in items %}
reference.description: Loop through context items; finish with endfor.

reference.name: {% if condition %}
reference.description: Choose content using if / elif / else / endif.

notes.title: Choose the output format
notes.body: HTML autoescape is enabled by default: B&O renders as B&O. Keep it for HTML, or pass autoescape := false for plain text. Escaping for SQL, JSON, and shell syntax is a separate concern.

notes.title: Keep values in the context
notes.body: Use minijinja_render_with_context for JSON built from row columns. Keep templates trusted. If generating SQL, bind untrusted data through prepared statements; template interpolation is not a substitute for SQL parameters.

examples.title: Render a message per row
examples.caption: Each row supplies its own context to the same template.

examples.title: Loop through a list
examples.sql:
SELECT minijinja_render_with_context(
  '{% for x in xs %}{{ x }}' ||
  '{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}' ||
  '{% endfor %}',
  '{"xs":["A","B","C"]}'
);
-- A, B, C
examples.caption: loop.last makes separators conditional without a trailing comma.

examples.title: Render unescaped plain text
examples.caption: Omit the option for HTML output: B&O.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN minijinja_render('Hello {{ name | upper }}!', '{"name":"Ada"}') = 'Hello ADA!' AND minijinja_render('{{ v }}', '{"v":"B&O"}') = 'B&O' AND minijinja_render('{{ v }}', '{"v":"B&O"}', autoescape := false) = 'B&O' AND minijinja_render_with_context('{% for x in xs %}{{ x }}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}', '{"xs":["A","B","C"]}') = 'A, B, C' THEN true ELSE error('MiniJinja result mismatch') END;
